definition: Own planter, an empty site with true v1-prefix entry legal, present budget after own requests covers phase-zero planting price, no friendly conflict in proposed destination, nearest enemy collector >=2, nearest enemy planter >=3, sum of currently visible non-tree/base resource neighbors >= planting price; MOVE estimates arrival only. Cash events are actual source-tape receipts, with source map/seat/turn/worker identity. All turns are included, without terminal utility cutoff; public coverage is a heuristic and not an independent causal label.
